distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) described Anisandrus xuannu from Chongqing and Sichuan. Smith et al. (2022) confirms those areas and adds Fujian.

host_note: Fagaceae is retained as the family-level host from Smith et al. (2020).
taxonomy_summary: Anisandrus xuannu Smith, Beaver & Cognato, 2020 was described as a new species by Smith et al. (2020) and is the current accepted identity.

taxonomic_history.name: Anisandrus xuannu
taxonomic_history.note: Described as a new species; original-description p. 111.

nomenclature_note: No additional synonyms or historical combinations are currently linked to this taxon in the integrated backbone.
